messages:
olivia: Postmortem follow-up from tonight's cross-region instability. Root cause appears to be intermittent resolver rate-limits combined with LB affinity replay. I sketched short/long actions below; please claim ownership and ETAs.

harry: I'll take the short mitigations: reduce sticky-affinity TTL to 30s for affected routes, add quick resolver blacklist after 3 SERVFAILs, and temporarily increase probe parallelism. ETA ~24h.

lee: I'll own the longer-term items: routing-debounce (30s sliding window + 5% min change), affinity logic rewrite to consult resolver health, and a full sticky-route audit. Planning design doc; ETA 3w.

routing-bot: alert: region-asia-south1 DNS SERVFAILs rose to 4.2% at 2026-03-25T21:08Z. route_flip_count=5 in 12m.

olivia: Action matrix (short | long | owner | ETA):
- "reduce affinity TTL (canary)" | "affinity algorithm consult resolver_health" | harry/lee | 24h / 3w
- "blacklist resolver after 3 SERVFAILs" | "multi-resolver failover + per-request resolver_id telemetry" | harry/infra-team | 12h / 4w
- "increase probe freq (region canary)" | "audit sticky-route configs + dedicated-pool plan" | harry/lee | 24-48h / 4w

harry: uploaded pcap and probe logs to incidents bucket: s3://redwood-incidents/3154321000/artifacts/ and opened infra PRs for probe + blacklist changes. Canary will roll in 1h.

lee: I'll include trace tags (resolver_id, affinity_reason) in the routing traces so we can correlate downstream errors. ETA 1w. Also noting recurrence: similar pattern in 2025-11 and 2026-02; recommend adding resolver-health review to quarterly networking checklist.

olivia: I'll add owners/ETAs to the postmortem follow-up board and schedule a 15m sync tomorrow 09:00 PT to confirm short deploys. If anything slips, DM me. :thumbsup:
